item_verdicts.fallback_contract: pass: ForwardProfile._solve obtains the frozen-program result first and, only if it is not converged, invokes _accelerated_history_program(..., live_read_fallback=True). Its cache key includes live_read_fallback, so the direct live Newton program is compiled separately rather than added to the frozen graph. The H200 and CPU split-fallback route logs pass at commit 224a3b967.
item_verdicts.frozen_partition_contract: pass: fixed_point.py reads the partition after live warmup, passes the carried partition into each frozen Newton trip, then calls partition_read(solved_state, mask) for live requalification before carrying the next pass. The H200 receipt records two frozen passes, three partition reads, and one re-freeze.
item_verdicts.gate_arms: pass with qualification: the reviewed manifest's declared baseline_suite is a deliberate red control at d6dd846e1 (one expected failing id, exit 1); after_suite is the repaired focused guard at de11143a0 (zero failures, exit 0). The later accelerator receipts test the complete fallback at 224a3b967 and the RCA receipt at 28b74cae4, all ancestors of reviewed head dfcda3dbb.
item_verdicts.goal: pass: the repair makes a frozen active-set pass refuse settlement above the unchanged 1e-6 tolerance, then runs a separately compiled live-map Newton fallback. The returned H200 route converges at live residual 1.282728063088e-11, not at the frozen objective.
item_verdicts.termination_contract: pass: the changed settled predicate now requires selected_residual <= convergence_tolerance when freeze_topology is true. The existing converged predicate also requires the same live residual and a zero live partition difference. The negative-control suite proves that the prior unconditional frozen settlement stops at one trip with residual 0.5, while the repaired code exhausts all three bounded trips and leaves converged false.
item_verdicts.tolerance: pass: the source diff contains no changed tolerance constant or widened threshold; the only new tolerance use compares selected_residual to the existing convergence_tolerance.

raw_text: VERDICT pass (92/100; goal_fidelity 19, evidence 18, scope_discipline 19, durability 17, fit 19). The independent source review confirms that frozen Newton passes retain one partition, re-read the live partition between passes, and cannot settle or report converged on a frozen objective above the unchanged tolerance. The falsifying control still reproduces the old one-trip frozen settlement at residual 0.5; the repaired focused test passes. A cache-distinct direct live Newton fallback is used only after a nonconverged frozen result. Its H200 and CPU accelerator-route receipts pass, and the post-change H200 RCA receipt records converged=true at live residual 1.282728063088e-11 with 2 frozen passes, 3 live partition reads, and 1 live-read Newton step. The originating run missed only its visual/fragment delivery deadline; that remains a follow-on, not a solver-gate failure. added_failure_count is 0, derived from the reviewed run's declared completed baseline/after arms.
